impact: NBIS heads into Thursday's premarket report on a strong rebound, which raises the bar for results; CoreWeave's shift away from unsecured debt eases one financing worry for the neocloud group.
source: Reuters via Globe and Mail / CNBC
summary: CoreWeave rose 13.7% premarket Wednesday after its Q3 beat and raised outlook, and said it will give up unsecured public debt in favour of delayed-draw facilities. Nebius, IREN, Oracle and Applied Digital climbed between 4.7% and 11.8% premarket, and Nvidia rose about 5% to around $177. Nasdaq-100 futures were up about 1.9% and S&P 500 futures about 1%.
title: Neoclouds jump premarket: CoreWeave +13.7%, Nebius and peers up 4.7%-11.8%
